verse.unicode: ਤਿਲੰਗ ਮਃ ੧ ॥

transliteration.english: tila(n)g mahalaa pehilaa ||

en.bdb: Tilang, First Mehla:

verse.unicode: ਇਆਨੜੀਏ ਮਾਨੜਾ ਕਾਇ ਕਰੇਹਿ ॥

transliteration.english: eiaanaRe'e maanaRaa kai kareh ||

en.bdb: O foolish and ignorant soul-bride, why are you so proud?

verse.unicode: ਆਪਨੜੈ ਘਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੋ ਕੀ ਨ ਮਾਣੇਹਿ ॥

transliteration.english: aapanaRai ghar har ra(n)go kee na maaneh ||

en.bdb: Within the home of your own self, why do you not enjoy the Love of your Lord?

verse.unicode: ਸਹੁ ਨੇੜੈ ਧਨ ਕੰਮਲੀਏ ਬਾਹਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਢੂਢੇਹਿ ॥

transliteration.english: sahu neRai dhan ka(n)male'ee baahar kiaa ddooddeh ||

en.bdb: Your Husband Lord is so very near, O foolish bride; why do you search for Him outside?

verse.unicode: ਭੈ ਕੀਆ ਦੇਹਿ ਸਲਾਈਆ ਨੈਣੀ ਭਾਵ ਕਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੋ ॥

transliteration.english: bhai keeaa dheh salaieeaa nainee bhaav kaa kar seegaaro ||

en.bdb: Apply the Fear of God as the maascara to adorn your eyes, and make the Love of the Lord your ornament.

verse.unicode: ਤਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਲਾਗੀ ਜਾ ਸਹੁ ਧਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੋ ॥੧॥

transliteration.english: taa sohaagan jaaneeaai laagee jaa sahu dhare piaaro ||1||

en.bdb: Then, you shall be known as a devoted and committed soul-bride, when you enshrine love for your Husband Lord. ||1||

verse.unicode: ਇਆਣੀ ਬਾਲੀ ਕਿਆ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਧਨ ਕੰਤ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥

transliteration.english: eiaanee baalee kiaa kare jaa dhan ka(n)t na bhaavai ||

en.bdb: What can the silly young bride do, if she is not pleasing to her Husband Lord?

verse.unicode: ਕਰਣ ਪਲਾਹ ਕਰੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥

transliteration.english: karan palaeh kare bahutere saa dhan mahal na paavai ||

en.bdb: She may plead and implore so many times, but still, such a bride shall not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

verse.unicode: ਵਿਣੁ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰਾ ਧਾਵੈ ॥

transliteration.english: vin karamaa kichh paieeaai naahee je bahuteraa dhaavai ||

en.bdb: Without the karma of good deeds, nothing is obtained, although she may run around frantically.

verse.unicode: ਲਬ ਲੋਭ ਅਹੰਕਾਰ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥

transliteration.english: lab lobh aha(n)kaar kee maatee maiaa maeh samaanee ||

en.bdb: She is intoxicated with greed, pride and egotism, and engrossed in Maya.

verse.unicode: ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਹੀ ਭਈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਇਆਣੀ ॥੨॥

transliteration.english: einee baatee sahu paieeaai naahee bhiee kaaman iaanee ||2||

en.bdb: She cannot obtain her Husband Lord in these ways; the young bride is so foolish! ||2||

verse.unicode: ਜਾਇ ਪੁਛਹੁ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਵਾਹੈ ਕਿਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥

transliteration.english: jai puchhahu sohaaganee vaahai kinee baatee sahu paieeaai ||

en.bdb: Go and ask the happy, pure soul-brides, how did they obtain their Husband Lord?

verse.unicode: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਭਲਾ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹਿਕਮਤਿ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥

transliteration.english: jo kichh kare so bhalaa kar maaneeaai hikamat hukam chukaieeaai ||

en.bdb: Whatever the Lord does, accept that as good; do away with your own cleverness and self-will.

verse.unicode: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਤਉ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥

transliteration.english: jaa kai prem padhaarath paieeaai tau charanee chit laieeaai ||

en.bdb: By His Love, true wealth is obtained; link your consciousness to His lotus feet.

verse.unicode: ਸਹੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋ ਕੀਜੈ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੋ ਦੀਜੈ ਐਸਾ ਪਰਮਲੁ ਲਾਈਐ ॥

transliteration.english: sahu kahai so keejai tan mano dheejai aaisaa paramal laieeaai ||

en.bdb: As your Husband Lord directs, so you must act; surrender your body and mind to Him, and apply this perfume to yourself.

verse.unicode: ਏਵ ਕਹਹਿ ਸੋਹਾਗਣੀ ਭੈਣੇ ਇਨੀ ਬਾਤੀ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥

transliteration.english: ev kaheh sohaaganee bhaine inee baatee sahu paieeaai ||3||

en.bdb: So speaks the happy soul-bride, O sister; in this way, the Husband Lord is obtained. ||3||

verse.unicode: ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਈਐ ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਅਉਰੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: aap gavaieeaai taa sahu paieeaai aaur kaisee chaturaiee ||

en.bdb: Give up your selfhood, and so obtain your Husband Lord; what other clever tricks are of any use?

verse.unicode: ਸਹੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਲੇਖੈ ਕਾਮਣਿ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: sahu nadhar kar dhekhai so dhin lekhai kaaman nau nidh paiee ||

en.bdb: When the Husband Lord looks upon the soul-bride with His Gracious Glance, that day is historic - the bride obtains the nine treasures.

verse.unicode: ਆਪਣੇ ਕੰਤ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਸਾ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾ ਸਭਰਾਈ ॥

transliteration.english: aapane ka(n)t piaaree saa sohaagan naanak saa sabharaiee ||

en.bdb: She who is loved by her Husband Lord, is the true soul-bride; O Nanak, she is the queen of all.

verse.unicode: ਐਸੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜ ਕੀ ਮਾਤੀ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਭਾਇ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥

transliteration.english: aaisai ra(n)g raatee sahaj kee maatee ahinis bhai samaanee ||

en.bdb: Thus she is imbued with His Love, intoxicated with delight; day and night, she is absorbed in His Love.

verse.unicode: ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਇ ਸਰੂਪ ਬਿਚਖਣਿ ਕਹੀਐ ਸਾ ਸਿਆਣੀ ॥੪॥੨॥੪॥

transliteration.english: su(n)dhar sai saroop bichakhan kaheeaai saa siaanee ||4||2||4||

en.bdb: She is beautiful, glorious and brilliant; she is known as truly wise. ||4||2||4||
